tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.when_the_wind: The earth delights to feel your bare feet, and the winds long to play with your hair.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.lullaby.maxim: In dreams I forget I am a guest, and snatch a moment of joy.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.fire_waltz.ma: The bear that ate garlic and mugwort became human.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.crimson_heart: Where the lover's blood fell, red tulips grew.

tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.absolution.ma: The weak can never forgive; forgiveness is the attribute of the strong.

tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.prussian_leap: Once you have tasted flight, you will forever walk the earth with your eyes turned skyward.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.may_kiss.maxi: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.

tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.breath_of_anc: To speak the name of the dead is to make them live again.

tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.tender_thorns: O my luve is like a red, red rose.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.coronation.ma: Gold is the sweat of the sun.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.voracious_urn: I care more about Drosera than the origin of all the species in the world.

tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.vernal_awaken: When you plant a seed, believe in the whole spring.

tooltip.kaleidoscope_flora.springtime_st: Wanderer, there is no road; the road is made by walking.
